# Hikma

> Hikma (command: `hikma`) is a command-line tool for scaffolding, sharing, and installing reusable AI-agent skills through a GitHub repository you own, called a registry. It works with Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, and custom agent layouts. Skills follow you: publish them from any project, install them into any other.

Install: `brew install HasanKhatib/tap/hikma`, or `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HasanKhatib/hikma-ai/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`. Source: https://github.com/HasanKhatib/hikma-ai (MIT licence).

Hikma is not a marketplace and has no hosted registry: a registry is a plain GitHub repo you configure. To search for skills, use `gh skill`; Hikma's `skill import` copies one into your registry after a review.

## Start here

- [Getting started](https://hikma.alkhatib.tech/getting-started): install, set up a project, and pick a path
- [The menu](https://hikma.alkhatib.tech/guides/menu): run `hikma` with no arguments for a guided session
- [Glossary](https://hikma.alkhatib.tech/guides/glossary): skill, registry, agent, lockfile

## Commands

- [All commands](https://hikma.alkhatib.tech/commands/): grouped by workflow
- [init](https://hikma.alkhatib.tech/commands/init): set up a repository for one or more agents
- [skill install](https://hikma.alkhatib.tech/commands/skill-install): install skills from your registry
- [skill import](https://hikma.alkhatib.tech/commands/skill-import): copy a skill from anywhere into your registry, after a review
- [skill create](https://hikma.alkhatib.tech/commands/skill-create): scaffold a new skill
- [skill push](https://hikma.alkhatib.tech/commands/skill-push): publish a skill to your registry
- [skill update](https://hikma.alkhatib.tech/commands/skill-update): update installed skills
- [skill verify](https://hikma.alkhatib.tech/commands/skill-verify): check installed skills against the lockfile, offline
- [sync](https://hikma.alkhatib.tech/commands/sync): restore every skill recorded in the lockfile
- [upgrade](https://hikma.alkhatib.tech/commands/upgrade): replace hikma with the latest release
